findings.rationale: Several result-specific branches fail open when their required sibling field is absent or has the wrong type: approval_check treats every non-signature-invalid or missing status as success, while format_check, lint, and semantic_diff similarly accept missing or malformed changed, finding_count, or violations fields. Because the CLI normalizes its exit status from this classification, an internally inconsistent producer envelope can be reported with exit zero instead of surfacing as an internal failure.
